findings.evidence: In _read_state, the permission validation tests 'stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) & 0o077', whereas _read_private in brain_admin_elevate.py enforces 'stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) != 0o600'. Consequently, modes such as 0700 are accepted by _read_state despite being rejected by _read_private and test_
findings.title: Permission check in _read_state allows modes that _read_private rejects

findings.evidence: In test helper within(), threading.Thread target is 'lambda: outcome.append(call())', which leaves outcome empty whenever call() raises an unhandled exception. The subsequent assertion 'self.assertTrue(outcome, ...)' reports that 'the hook did not return in time', masking the actual exception raised
findings.title: Test helper within() reports timeouts when target call raises exceptions
